disease: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1A (CMT1A; PMP22 17p11.2 tandem duplication -- single-gene dosage excess)
suspended_reason: The cause is a single-gene DOSAGE EXCESS produced by a ~1.4-Mb GENOMIC TANDEM DUPLICATION at chromosome 17p11.2-p12 that carries a THIRD complete copy of PMP22 -- not a sequence-level promoter switch the kit can read. In the normal genome PMP22 is present in two copies; the CMT1A duplication adds a third functional copy, so peripheral myelin protein 22 is OVER-expressed by gene DOSAGE, the Schwann cell dysmyelinates, and a progressive length-dependent peripheral neuropathy emerges (CMT1A is the COMMONEST inherited neuropathy, more than half of all Charcot-Marie-Tooth, prevalence about 1 in 2500). The PMP22 promoter SEQUENCE is perfectly readable as reference DNA (gamma 1.3883, chr17) and is NOT mutated; the lesion is a COPY-NUMBER GAIN of the whole locus. The emergence engine reads ONE promoter's switch-threshold (gamma) per locus; it has NO representation of 'how many copies of this promoter exist', so a gene-dosage DUPLICATION is invisible to a single-locus gamma read -- just as a whole-chromosome aneuploidy (Down) or a contiguous-gene microdeletion (DiGeorge) is, but here the change is a SUB-CHROMOSOMAL, single-gene-centric copy-number GAIN. This is the kit's TENTH distinct held mechanism class -- after (1) whole-chromosome aneuploidy, (2) genomic imprinting, (3) repeat-CONTRACTION chromatin derepression, (4) mtDNA point mutation, (5) mtDNA large-scale deletion, (6) contiguous-gene microDELETION, (7) repeat-EXPANSION promoter methylation-silencing, (8) post-zygotic somatic mosaicism, and (9) repeat-EXPANSION toxic-RNA spliceopathy -- being the FIRST copy-number GAIN / gene-DUPLICATION-dosage hold, and the reciprocal MIRROR of HNPP (hereditary neuropathy with liability to pressure palsies), which is the SAME 1.4-Mb region DELETED -> PMP22 haploinsufficiency. CMT1A is the canonical 'gene dosage' disease (3 copies -> CMT1A; 1 copy -> HNPP; 2 -> normal), a clean demonstration that COPY-NUMBER, not promoter sequence, is the lesion. Suspended PURELY on engine-readability, NOT for lack of therapeutic interest: there is NO approved disease-modifying or curative drug -- clinical management is multidisciplinary supportive care plus ankle-foot orthoses and corrective surgery (a PHYSICAL / rehabilitative track) -- while the dosage-lowering combination PXT3003 (baclofen / naltrexone / sorbitol, which suppresses PMP22 over-expression) completed a Phase III trial and is not yet approved, and PMP22-targeting antisense oligonucleotides / gene-editing remain investigational. PMP22 gamma 1.3883 chr17 is recorded as reference only; the disease is held, disclosed not dropped.
discipline: no analyzable single-gene DNA read -> held (author's rule). Disclosed, not dropped.
